theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (y : Euclid (m + 1)) (r R : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → (∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → 0 < r → closedBall y (r * R) ⊆ D → ∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) R → ∫ w in (fun w => y + r • w) ⁻¹' F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g w : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) = -(r ^ m)⁻¹ * ∫ z, inner ℝ (g (r⁻¹ • (z - y))) (ν z) ∂μ
